programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Italian director Franco Zeffirelli stunned the screen world when he cast two young unknowns to portray the star-crossed lovers in Romeo & Juliet, but it was a gamble that resulted in one of the most popular motion pictures of all time.

programme.title: The Masque of the Red Death (1964)
programme.desc: When the sadistic prince (Vincent Price) finds that the Red Death has arrived in the village he rules, he forsakes his people and hides in his castle with his fellow aristocrats…until a mysterious stranger turns his haven into a danse macabre!

programme.title: Eyes Without A Face
programme.desc: A surgeon causes an accident which leaves his daughter disfigured and goes to extreme lengths to give her a new face.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: The Dark Half
programme.desc: A writer undergoes an operation that reveals a twin in his brain. He begins a double writing life, using a pseudonym for his disreputable best-sellers. When the pseudonym discovers he is to be eradicated, he goes on a murderous rampage.

programme.title: The Dead Zone

programme.title: Little Nicky

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: Menace II Society
programme.desc: In an unflinching look at the mean streets of the contemporary urban American ghetto, a Black youth—despite his dreams for a better life—ultimately succumbs to the cycle of violence that pervades his community.

programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: Double Dragon
programme.desc: Evil meets its match in this daring martial arts adventure about two teen brothers out to stop an obsessed tycoon from finding both halves of a mystical talisman.

programme.title: Billy Madison
programme.desc: 27-year-old Billy Madison must repeat all 12 grades of school to earn his father's respect and prove he has what it takes to run the family business.

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Steve Buscemi and Julianne Moore star in this Coen brothers’ cult comedy about the Dude, his buddies, a case of mistaken identity, kidnapping and bowling.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Nicholas Angel is an unstoppable cop who, with the help of his bumbling partner, delivers some big-city justice in a small, quiet town.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: St. Elmo's Fire
programme.desc: Seven friends, recent college graduates, are searching for a place in the real world as they face issues of career and commitment. Rating: R

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Widows
programme.desc: When four armed robbers are killed, their widows take fate into their own hands.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: When her home is invaded by three armed robbers, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in their specially designed panic room, but end up in a deadly cat-and-mouse game anyway.

programme.title: Sense and Sensibility
programme.desc: Emma Thompson stars in the captivating romance based on Jane Austen's classic novel of two sisters' search for love in strict Victorian society.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: In turn-of-the-century Vienna, a magician uses his abilities to secure the love of a woman far above his social standing.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson and wound his son.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Funnyman Adam Sandler stars in MR. DEEDS, the hilarious remake of the classic American comedy Mr. Deeds Goes to Town.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burnout who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Disturbing Behavior
programme.desc: When the Clark Family moves from Chicago to Cradle Bay, Steve is cautioned by Gavin Strick about the separating factions at the local high school, where the Blue Ribbons, a club of robotic perfect students, rule.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back. After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Taking care of Arnie is mostly Gilbert's task, which can be pretty demanding, at least while you are working at the local grocery store.

programme.title: Freedom Writers
programme.desc: Hilary Swank stars in this story about a teacher in a racially divided school who gives her students what they’ve always needed - a voice.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and New York during the 1910s, then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: High School High
programme.desc: From the creators of the Naked Gun series comes High School High. Richard C. Clark is an idealistic young teacher who leaves a position at a prestigious school headed by his own father to teach at Marion Barry High.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Ninja
programme.desc: Chris Farley, Nicollette Sheridan, and Chris Rock star in this comic crash of cultures about a talentless Ninja determined to save a mysterious damsel in distress.

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: An amusement park of the future caters to any adult fantasy. Lifelike androids carry out your every whim. A fun place, right? Not so, as a reporter and his Girl Friday find out while on a press junket to the newly opened Futureworld...

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13 (1976)
programme.desc: The isolated inhabitants of an abandoned police station are under attack by the overwhelming numbers of a seemingly unstoppable street gang.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes on a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: Latency
programme.desc: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

programme.title: Mindcage
programme.desc: When a copycat murderer strikes, Detectives Jake Doyle and Mary Kelly seek help from an incarcerated serial killer named the Artist. As Mary delves deep into the Artist's twisted psyche, she and Jake get lured into a diabolical game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: House Party
programme.desc: When party time comes, it's time to tear the house down! If they get caught, it's all over. But if they don't, it's just the beginning! Kid 'N Play stars in the uproarious comedy that launched the House Party craze.

programme.title: House Party 2
programme.desc: High school is over, but the party is not. Join Kid n' Play for a hip-hop college adventure in House Party 2. Kid decides to pursue college, but when Play loses Kid's tuition money, the two boys have to devise a new plan -the wildest one yet!

programme.title: House Party 3
programme.desc: Prepare yourself for the ultimate house party: Kid gets engaged...and Play plans the bachelor party in House Party 3.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Four teenagers in detention discover an old video game console with a game they’ve never heard of. When they decide to play, they are immediately sucked into the jungle world of Jumanji in the bodies of their avatars.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: Rocky Balboa
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor (1996)
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities — disrupting new mama Jody’s dancing aspirations in the “Swan Lake” ballet and threatening Dan’s rise as an ape researcher.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: X (2022)
programme.desc: A group of actors set out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

programme.title: MST3K: Pod People
programme.desc: A child adopts a large egg which hatches into a mischievous alien, while a group of pop musicians on a wilderness vacation runs into trouble.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
programme.desc: A hapless family on a car trip in rural Texas takes refuge at a lodge that is secretly the home of a deadly cult.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Killer Shrews
programme.desc: An experiment on a remote island goes awfully awry when Professor Marlowe Cragis and his research team accidentally create giant, venomous shrews.

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: People shouldn't feed these animals.

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: No matter how much makeup is put on it, a fail is a fail.

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: All extreme, all the time.

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: A definitive collection of expensive fails seen on the internet; not everyone gets away with just a free kick in the nuts; cars get wrecked, houses destroyed, rockets explode and silos collapse, and all of these fails cost a pretty penny.

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: The favorite alma mater of Fail U.

programme.title: World's Most Expensive Fails
programme.desc: Working on fitness, just to fail.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Fails
programme.desc: Wilderness, selfies and family trips collide as nature unleashes chaos across every element and angle!

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Fails
programme.desc: Highway mayhem, beastly blow-ups and family fails prove that the journey is the real adventure and disaster!

programme.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
programme.desc: Dewey Cox had it all: the women (over 411), the friends (Elvis), and the rock 'n' roll lifestyle (every pill and powder). But most of all, he had the music that transformed a dimwitted country boy into the greatest American rock star who never lived.

programme.title: Dinner for Schmucks
programme.desc: There’s only one thing keeping aspiring executive Tim from corporate success. He must find the perfect guest to bring to his boss’s monthly dinner party, where the winner of the evening is the one who arrives with the biggest buffoon.

programme.title: Joe Dirt
programme.desc: Joe Dirt is a janitor with a mullet, acid-washed jeans, and a dream -- to find the parents he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was a belligerent, trailer park-raised kid. Now, the irrepressibly optimistic Joe hits the road in search of his folks.

programme.title: RiffTrax: House on Haunted Hill: Three Riffer Edition
programme.desc: Long before lunatic millionaires Michael Jackson or Rick Rockwell, there was Vincent Price's Frederic Loren, an eccentric, unhappily married fop who offers a huge cash prize to anyone who can stay overnight in the house on Haunted Hill.

programme.title: RiffTrax: Blood Theatre
programme.desc: Every time the Blood Theatre opened for business, someone died. But this time, the theater has a good feeling about its chances! This feature is a parody and contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

programme.title: RiffTrax: The Most Dangerous Game
programme.desc: The Most Dangerous Game encounters problems right out of the gate when it turns out to NOT be about playing Twister nude with an angry badger. This feature contains the original movie combined with a comedic commentary from RiffTrax (formerly of MST3K).

programme.title: RiffTrax: Aladdin
programme.desc: Long before there was a terrible Disney live-action version of Aladdin, there was a terrible Disney live-action version of Aladdin! This feature is a parody and contains a comedic commentary by RiffTrax.

programme.title: Hot in Cleveland
programme.desc: At Max's lake house, Melanie finds out the new man in her life is actually Joy's ex-fiance Kyle, and a spider with paralyzing effects runs rampant.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris

programme.title: The Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: A waning director revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and makes her into a Hollywood star. Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart and Edmond O’Brien star in this bitter tale of stardom won and wasted from Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

programme.title: Trapeze
programme.desc: Aerialist Burt Lancaster--who retired after suffering an injury--agrees to train aspiring trapeze artist Tony Curtis. But when both men fall in love with the beautiful and ambitious Gina Lollobrigida, the triangle threaten the dreams of them all.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: Secret Window
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominee Johnny Depp (2003 Best Actor, Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl) gives his most riveting performance in this action/suspense thriller featuring a top-notch cast.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Corrupt detectives Tupac Shakur and James Belushi, having framed an innocent man (Dennis Quaid) for the murder of an undercover DEA agent, find their lives unraveling when they come under the scrutiny of DEA investigator Richard Simms (Gary Cole).

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Double Dragon
programme.desc: Evil meets its match in this daring martial arts adventure about two teen brothers out to stop an obsessed tycoon from finding both halves of a mystical talisman.

programme.title: Street Fighter II: The Animated Movie
programme.desc: Based on the legendary video game series. This anime classic follows Ryu, a talented fighter who may be the greatest in all of the world, and Bison, the evil mastermind searching for Ryu's talents.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: A defenseless man is kidnapped by an organized crime syndicate and turned into a ruthless assassin.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Nicholas Angel is an unstoppable cop who, with the help of his bumbling partner, delivers some big-city justice in a small, quiet town.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Joe Dirt
programme.desc: Joe Dirt is a janitor with a mullet, acid-washed jeans, and a dream -- to find the parents he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was a belligerent, trailer park-raised kid. Now, the irrepressibly optimistic Joe hits the road in search of his folks.

programme.title: Pretty In Pink
programme.desc: She’s a high school girl from the wrong side of town. He’s the wealthy heartthrob who asks her to the prom. But as fast as their romance builds, it’s threatened by the painful reality of peer pressure.

programme.title: Some Kind of Wonderful (1987)
programme.desc: In this story from legendary filmmaker John Hughes, Keith, Watts and Amanda prove that you've got to risk a broken heart in order to find your one true love. This unforgettable romantic comedy has laughs, romance and is truly Some Kind of Wonderful.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: Panic Room
programme.desc: When her home is invaded by three armed robbers, a divorced woman and her young daughter hide in their specially designed panic room, but end up in a deadly cat-and-mouse game anyway.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

programme.title: Trading Paint
programme.desc: A down-and-out stock car racing legend (John Travolta) is drawn back to the dirt track when his son (Toby Sebastian), an aspiring driver, joins a rival racing team, which sparks an intense and dangerous competition between father and son.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: In turn-of-the-century Vienna, a magician uses his abilities to secure the love of a woman far above his social standing.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: Big Jake
programme.desc: An aging Texas cattle man who has outlived his time swings into action when outlaws kidnap his grandson and wound his son.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!

programme.title: The Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: A waning director revives his career after discovering a beautiful Spanish dancer and makes her into a Hollywood star. Ava Gardner, Humphrey Bogart and Edmond O’Brien star in this bitter tale of stardom won and wasted from Joseph L. Mankiewicz.

programme.title: Trapeze
programme.desc: Aerialist Burt Lancaster--who retired after suffering an injury--agrees to train aspiring trapeze artist Tony Curtis. But when both men fall in love with the beautiful and ambitious Gina Lollobrigida, the triangle threaten the dreams of them all.

programme.title: Houdini
programme.desc: Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: A new technologically-superior Soviet nuclear sub is heading for the U.S. coast; however, one CIA analyst thinks the captain will defect the submarine, and he only has hours to prove it.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: Jack Ryan is caught in the middle of a terrorist attack. Ryan helps to thwart Holmes’ assailants and becomes a local hero. But Ryan’s act marks him as a target. Now he must return to action to save his family.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Stephen King's Silver Bullet
programme.desc: Something is killing off townsfolk in Tarker's Mills. Something ingenious. Something remotely human. But the only person in town with courage to stop this lurking menace is a 13-year-old boy, confined to a wheelchair since birth.

programme.title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
programme.desc: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience. Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: A defenseless man is kidnapped by an organized crime syndicate and turned into a ruthless assassin.

programme.title: DOA: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: The world's best fighters are invited to DOA, a martial-arts tournament. Four female rival fighters, an aristocratic warrior, a wrestling superstar, an athlete with a tragic past, and an assassin-for-hire, work together to uncover a secret.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: Joe Dirt
programme.desc: Joe Dirt is a janitor with a mullet, acid-washed jeans, and a dream -- to find the parents he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was a belligerent, trailer park-raised kid. Now, the irrepressibly optimistic Joe hits the road in search of his folks.

programme.title: Clue
programme.desc: Meet all the notorious suspects and discover their foul playthings. You'll love their dastardly doings as the bodies and the laughs pile up before your eyes. Featuring all three surprise endings!!

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: The Cutting Edge
programme.desc: Action and romance take to the screen when a self-centered ex-hockey star (D.B. Sweeney) and a prima donna champion figure skater (Moira Kelly) become unlikely partners in pursuit of Olympic gold.

programme.title: Strictly Ballroom
programme.desc: A championship ballroom dancer finds inspiration within, and decides he'll stop at nothing to win, even if it means rewriting the rules. A worldwide feel-good hit, with an incredible soundtrack, from director Baz Luhrmann (MOULIN ROUGE!).

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

programme.title: Trading Paint
programme.desc: A down-and-out stock car racing legend (John Travolta) is drawn back to the dirt track when his son (Toby Sebastian), an aspiring driver, joins a rival racing team, which sparks an intense and dangerous competition between father and son.

programme.title: Blue Ruin
programme.desc: BLUE RUIN is a classic American revenge story, following a mysterious outsider whose quiet life is turned upside down when he returns to his childhood home, determined to carry out an act of vengeance.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut)
programme.desc: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: John Wayne plays Hondo Lane, a cavalry rider who becomes the protector of Angie Lowe as well as a father figure to her boy, Johnny. Angie, determinedly awaiting the return of her husband, refuses to leave their homestead despite the growing danger.

programme.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
programme.desc: Jimmy Stewart plays the bungling but charming big-city lawyer determined to rid the fair village of Shinbone of its number one nuisance and bad man: Liberty Valance.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: The four rowdy sons of Katie Elder return home for her funeral and to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: The Host (2013)
programme.desc: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Mallrats
programme.desc: Two loafers who spend way too much time at the mall try to win back their girlfriends with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay.

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

programme.title: Wishmaster
programme.desc: From executive producer Wes Craven comes this fantasy-horror cult classic that spawned three sequels. When a jewelry appraiser is given an ancient gem, she unwittingly unleashes an immortal spirit that grants humans wishes in exchange for their souls.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Seven complete strangers of widely varying personality characteristics are involuntarily placed in an endless maze containing deadly traps.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: Mimic 3: Sentinel
programme.desc: In the third creature feature in the MIMIC franchise, the bugs are back. After a group of people begins to disappear, a man hypersensitive to germs and confined to a protective bubble, decides to play detective.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st Airborne Division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Necessary Roughness
programme.desc: The Texas State Armadillos are fourth down and nowhere-to-go after a corruption scandal nearly ends the football program. Now upstanding coach Ed Gennero (Hector Elizondo) must put together a brand-new team.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Taking care of Arnie is mostly Gilbert's task, which can be pretty demanding, at least while you are working at the local grocery store.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: High School High
programme.desc: From the creators of the Naked Gun series comes High School High. Richard C. Clark is an idealistic young teacher who leaves a position at a prestigious school headed by his own father to teach at Marion Barry High.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura, Pet Detective, is on the case to find the Miami Dolphins' missing mascot and quarterback, Dan Marino. He goes eye-to-eye with sharks, stakes out the Miami Dolphins, and woos and wows the ladies. He always gets his man...or beast.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Africa's the place where Ace is on the case, setting out to rescue an animal he loathes - a bat! If you're ready to laugh like a pack of hyenas, if you want more fun than an industrial-sized barrel of monkeys, you'll know what to do. Heed the call.

programme.title: Don't Look Now
programme.desc: On a trip to Venice, a young couple whose daughter has just died meet a psychic who leads them into a frightening and suspenseful experience. Based on a novel by Daphne Du Maurier.

programme.title: The Warriors
programme.desc: The armies of the night number 100,000; they outnumber the police 5 to 1; and tonight they're after the Warriors.

programme.title: Burnt Offerings
programme.desc: Karen Black, Oliver Reed, and Bette Davis star in this riveting haunted-house chiller that delivers hidden terrors as a family finds itself surrounded by an evil, hypnotic living presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder. Dan Curtis directs.

programme.title: Shin Ultraman
programme.desc: A silver giant descends from the sky to rescue the planet. Dubbed Ultraman, this giant's identity and purpose are a mystery.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Frankenstein's monster becomes involved in a war between two immortal clans.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes on a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Serendipity
programme.desc: In the course of one magical evening, Jonathan (John Cusack) and Sara (Kate Beckinsale) meet unexpectedly, but part ways, determining that fate will guide their future if they're meant to be together.

programme.title: I Love You, Man
programme.desc: A friendless groom-to-be meets the ultimate dude and the two begin a "bro-mance" which takes male-bonding to hilarious new heights that will keep you laughing to the end.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: A war-hardened Crusader and his Moorish commander mount an audacious revolt against the corrupt English crown.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: Jeff Bauman loses both of his legs when two bombs explode during the Boston Marathon on April 15, 2013. With unwavering support from his family and girlfriend, Bauman embarks on a long and heroic journey to physical and emotional rehabilitation.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: A dramatization of the disaster in April 2010, when the offshore drilling rig called the Deepwater Horizon exploded, resulting in the worst oil spill in American history.

programme.title: A Fish Called Wanda (1988)
programme.desc: Kevin Kline won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his role in this wildly popular comedy about an intricate diamond heist that's peppered with the comical antics of Jamie Lee Curtis and John Cleese.

programme.title: Girls Just Want To Have Fun
programme.desc: Janey is new in town and soon meets Lynne, who shares her passion for dancing in general and Dance TV in particular.

programme.title: Allied

programme.title: La mejor oferta

programme.title: Crimen en Primer Grado
programme.desc: Claire (Ashley Judd), una abogada dinámica, y su marido (James Caviezel), un contratista independiente de éxito, llevan una vida estupenda. Sin embargo, un delito fortuito en su hogar desencadena una serie de acontecimientos que hace añicos su mundo.

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida
programme.desc: Con las actuaciones de Hugh Jackman y Rachel Weisz, se entreteje un cuento acerca de la búsqueda de un hombre por encontrar "el árbol de la vida" que le dará vida eterna.

programme.title: Mátalos Suavemente
programme.desc: Cuando el criminal Johnny Amato idea un plan para robar en un juego de cartas organizado por el mafioso Markie, él elige a un ladrón llamado Frankie para hacer el trabajo.

programme.title: Frecuencia Mortal
programme.desc: Lewis Thomas (Paul Walker), estudiante de segundo año de universidad, emprende un viaje por carretera a través del país con la chica de sus sueños, Venna (Leelee Sobieski). Sin embargo, todo se tuerce cuando recoge a su hermano, Fuller (Steve Zahn).

programme.title: Asesino a sueldo
programme.desc: Un caso de identidad equivocada lleva a Slevin al centro de una guerra tramada por dos de los jefes criminales más rivales de la ciudad.

programme.title: El cascanueces
programme.desc: Esta alegre interpretación del clásico navideño cuenta la historia de una niña cuyo amor por un juguete lo transforma en un apuesto príncipe (Macaulay Culkin).

programme.title: Espía por casualidad
programme.desc: Spy By Chance cuenta la historia del niño Tim, de tan solo 10 años, cuando él y su familia se mudan a un antiguo hotel ubicado en la región costera del país.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Unos niños forman un club dedicado a los monstruos, pero pronto obtienen más de lo que esperaban cuando Drácula se retira a la Tierra, con el monstruo de Frankenstein, Wolfman, la Momia y el Gillman.

programme.title: Los Caballeros no tienen memoria
programme.desc: Richard es un brillante profesor de Cambridge con una pasión desenfrenada por la poesia romantíca y las mujeres hermosas. Sin embargo, la paternidad le cambiará la vida.

programme.title: Finding Love in Big Sky
programme.desc: Una campesina independiente asume la tarea de mantener el rancho de su adorado abuelo. Después de que se le negó la financiación necesaria para renovar el rancho, le presentan de nuevo a su exnovio, un importante ejecutivo de marketing destinado en Denver

programme.title: Abajo el Amor
programme.desc: Cuando la exitosa escritora feminista Barbara Novak se convierte en el objetivo del deslumbrante playboy Catcher Block , esta pareja dispareja genera chispas de diversión.

programme.title: Travesuras de una Princesa
programme.desc: La «primera hija» busca una experiencia universitaria normal, pero los peligros inherentes a su título la persiguen. Por ello, el Servicio Secreto asigna a un joven agente encubierto para vigilarla.

programme.title: Fuera de Limites
programme.desc: Un inquilino se niega a desocupar su casa en el último edificio programado para renovación en un vecindario en proceso de gentrificación. La situación con los desarrolladores inmobiliarios se intensifica hasta convertirse en un enfrentamiento brutal.

programme.title: Rumores
programme.desc: En medio de rumores sobre una relación inapropiada, una maestra en un pequeño pueblo se convierte en la principal sospechosa cuando una adolescente desaparece misteriosamente.

programme.title: El Último Disparo
programme.desc: Cuando a un fotógrafo le regalan una cámara antigua, descubre sin querer un oscuro secreto cuando tras ver que la última foto es la de una mujer asesinada.

programme.title: El Gavilán Justiciero
programme.desc: Historia llena de acción donde la codicia y la ambición desatan la mas cruenta lucha que trae como consecuencia el sufrimiento de una familia la envidia de otra.

programme.title: El Inocente
programme.desc: Un grupo de empresarios se dedican a negocios de bienes y raíces para tapar sus negocios chuecos del narcotráfico. La policía local anda pisándole los talones, pero no tienen pruebas para meterlos a la cárcel.

programme.title: El Mandadero
programme.desc: Silverio inicio su historia en la mafia como mandadero de los gatilleros, compra los cigarros, lleva los carros a lavar y una que otra carga pequeña de droga.

programme.title: El Motero
programme.desc: Los Morales son una familia numerosa de padre y madre e hijos que se dedican a los sembradíos de marihuana, en la familia hay dos hermanos Edgar, quien siempre ayuda a su familia y Gustavo quien es envidioso y no ayuda a su familia.

programme.title: El Ansia De Matar
programme.desc: Daniel y Raúl son dos hermanos con una relación estrecha, sin embargo, esto cambia con la muerte de su padre, pues al dar con el asesino Daniel decide quedarse en Durango para continuar con su vida de juego y Raúl se va a estudiar a otro estado.

programme.title: El Hijo Del Diablo
programme.desc: Victor Rincón es un contrabandista que hace quemar el rancho costeño de un viejo que no ha querido venderselo a bajo precio. El hijo del diablo, inmune a las balas, mata a unos esbirros de Victor para devolver al viejo su dinero.

programme.title: El Hombre Propone
programme.desc: Historia narrada a traves de tres cuentos escritos por Jacha. La primera de ella es ¡venganza!: al pobre músico Anselmo le hacen creer que dirigira una orquesta por television. Cuando descubre el engaño toma una pistola y mata al bromista.

programme.title: Callejón Sangriento
programme.desc: Elijah Kane está en una nueva misión para el gobierno después de que se le prometió que la CIA proporcionará información sobre quién lanzó un ataque contra su equipo anterior.

programme.title: Hermandad
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo se propusieron acabar con el Yakuza de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Código de honor
programme.desc: El coronel Robert Sikes tiene la misión de librar a su ciudad del crimen. Como un sigiloso equipo de asalto de un solo hombre, se enfrentará a pandillas callejeras, mafiosos y políticos con prejuicios extremos hasta que complete su misión.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Un accidente causa que O'Brien viaje al futuro cercano, donde presencia su propia muerte... y algo peor.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Bashir, que está en coma y muriendo luego de un ataque alienígena, debe acceder a distintas partes de su personalidad, que toman forma de miembros de la tripulación, para salvar su vida.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: En un universo paralelo, Sisko debe asumir el papel de su contraparte muerta para salvar la versión espejo de su difunta esposa.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: La tienda de Garak explota misteriosamente, lo que impulsa a Odo a investigar quién está intentando matar al exiliado cardasiano y por qué.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: En vísperas de un ataque romulano-cardasiano contra el Dominio, Garak quizá tenga que probar su lealtad a su antiguo mentor eliminando a Odo.

programme.title: Los Signos Del Apocalipsis

programme.desc: Siempre podrás disfrutar de las fabulosas cenas navideñas en familia y las despedidas de solteros. Por lo menos en esas fiestas no necesitas encontrar una chica que te pare bola.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Si la diversión sería hacer cosas responsables y tediosas, tal vez nos evitaríamos tantas malas pasadas en las fiestas. Menos mal que nos parece divertido todo lo que nos hace daño, y podemos reírnos de eso en este episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Necesitas una excusa para beber? En este episodio te daremos 5 buenas razones para borrar el cassette. Brinda con nosotros y recuerda, nunca es tarde para traumarse y volverse alcohólico.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Para animar una fiesta no necesitas buenos amigos, buena comida ni grandes conversaciones trascendentales. Lo único que necesitas es trago barato de dudosa reputación.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Quieres saber qué tipo de borracho eres? Rápido, mira este episodio y se te revelará el resultado al fondo de tu copa. Y si no te identificas es porque con nosotros no has tomado.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Ningún festejo en Latinoamérica esta completo sin cantidades ridículas de trago. Desde tu primera fiesta hasta las navidades en familia. Y lo seguimos consumiendo incluso cuando todos hemos dicho "nunca más volveré a tomar".

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Un episodio que lo tiene todo: romance, tragedia, suspenso, el verdadero significado de la navidad, mucho alcohol y al Chichico en pelotas. Brinda con nosotros y descubre cómo sobrevivir a una fiesta de oficina.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Enchufe.tv es un espacio de comedia de los mileniales latinos. Sabemos lo que les gusta y los hacemos reír. Aquí todo se vale.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Cybernet LT

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Te gustan los videojuegos de terror? En éste capítulo de Cybernet conoceremos el origen de una de las franquicias más famosas de survival horror de la industria: Resident Evil. También tenemos un Top 10 con los mejores juegos de terror de la historia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuánto dinero estarían dispuestos a pagar por su juego favorito? En el capítulo de hoy les contaremos cuáles han sido los juegos que más caro se han vendido en la historia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Saben qué es una secuela espiritual? Lo descubriremos en éste episodio de Cybernet. También conoceremos los mejores crossovers de los videojuegos en nuestro Top 10 y recordaremos algunos de los mejores juegos basados en películas.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Abran muy bien los ojos y pongan mucha atención, ya que hoy hablaremos de los secretos y easter eggs más famosos de los videojuegos. Conoceremos algunos de los juegos cancelados que más nos han dolido.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Tenemos que admitir que no todos los videojuegos son de buena calidad, y algunos de ellos son tan malos que se han vuelto de culto. En el episodio de hoy de Cybernet recordaremos a los peores juegos de la historia.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Como se predijo en las cintas enviadas a Sakura TV, presentadores de noticias y comentaristas que expresaron dudas sobre Kira mueren uno por uno. Siguiendo las muertes, L concluye que existe un segundo Kira.

programme.title: Death Note

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Phantom Racer
programme.desc: Un piloto de carreras regresa de la muerte para buscar venganza contra su antiguo rival.

programme.title: El Vuelo de la Muerte

programme.title: Only for One Night

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida
programme.desc: Con las actuaciones de Hugh Jackman y Rachel Weisz, se entreteje un cuento acerca de la búsqueda de un hombre por encontrar "el árbol de la vida" que le dará vida eterna.

programme.title: La Emboscada
programme.desc: Cuando el ladrón profesional Robert MacDougal se ve envuelto en un juego de intrigas internacionales, con la investigadora Gin Baker , los fraudes y trampas policiacas empiezan.

programme.title: Encuentro Explosivo
programme.desc: Cuando June conoce a un misterioso extraño, cree que ha encontrado al hombre de sus sueños pero descubre que es un súper espía fugitivo que la involucra en una emocionante persecución.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: Un veterano de LAPD debe ir en contra de la cultura policial de la que formó parte toda su carrera.

programme.title: Persecución Mortal

programme.title: La leyenda del gigante de la montaña

programme.title: K-Nino: La Leyenda del Oro Perdido

programme.title: Un Vecino con Pocas Luces

programme.title: El cascanueces

programme.title: Una vida en siete días

programme.title: Mi Super Ex-Novia

programme.title: La Falla

programme.title: The House

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: El mediador
programme.desc: Danny Roman es un experto negociador en secuestros, pero esta vez está del otro lado: obligado por una acusación falsa, ha secuestrado a las cabezas de Asuntos Internos, exigiendo mediador.

programme.title: Código Gerónimo La Caza de Bin Laden
programme.desc: Un grupo de Navy SEAL viene a conocer la identidad de su objetivo: Osama bin Laden.

programme.title: Gunman
programme.desc: Jim Terrier es una espía internacional que ha sido traicionado por la organización para la que trabajaba. Debido a ello decide dejar atrás su antigua vida de agente encubierto para casarse con su novia Annie y mudarse a otro estado.

programme.title: Negocios Fuera de Control
programme.desc: Tres emprendedores en un viaje de negocios a Europa se enfrentan a los obstáculos más disparatados que cabe imaginar en esta comedia desenfrenada protagonizada por Vince Vaughn, Dave Franco y Tom Wilkinson.

programme.title: Una Loca Película de Vampiros
programme.desc: Es una comedia sobre la ansiedad adolescente contemporánea y películas románticas. Becca una adolescente ansiosa, no vampiro, está confundida sobre dos chicos.

programme.title: No es otra pelÍcula de Amor
programme.desc: Nueva comedia de los creadores de "Scary Movie", que en esta ocasión parodian todo tipo de comedias románticas.

programme.title: El Vuelo de la Muerte
programme.desc: Fuerza sobrenatural aterroriza a los pasajeros de un avión.

programme.title: Hotel Del Miedo
programme.desc: Amy comienza su primer turno de noche en un hotel con un pasado asesino. Al ser testigo de eventos aterradores y atrapada en un bucle, Amy debe encontrar una manera de escapar del asesino obsesionado con la carne y salvar a los residentes del hotel.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Una escritora, en busca de paz y soledad, se va al campo para terminar su libro y recuperarse de la tragedia. Su estancia se convierte en un infierno al darse cuenta de que sus demonios internos no son su peor problema.

programme.title: Phantom Racer
programme.desc: Un piloto de carreras regresa de la muerte para buscar venganza contra su antiguo rival.

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida
programme.desc: Con las actuaciones de Hugh Jackman y Rachel Weisz, se entreteje un cuento acerca de la búsqueda de un hombre por encontrar "el árbol de la vida" que le dará vida eterna.

programme.title: Obsesión
programme.desc: Simon hereda una casa de campo a la que viaja con su familia. Su sueño es renovarla, pero cae en un romance prohibido. Ahora tendrá que estar dispuesta a llegar hasta las últimas consecuencias para recuperar su tranquilidad y a su familia.

programme.title: THE PERFECT GAME
programme.desc: Basado en una historia real. En 1957, un grupo de niños pobres de Monterrey, México, conmocionó al mundo al ganar 13 juegos seguidos y la Serie Mundial de Pequeñas Ligas en el único juego perfecto jamás lanzado en el Campeonato.

programme.title: Street Kings
programme.desc: Un veterano de LAPD debe ir en contra de la cultura policial de la que formó parte toda su carrera.

programme.title: Persecución Mortal
programme.desc: El ladrón lleva a cabo el robo de su vida cuando roba al psicótico señor de la droga, Temple. El plan se lleva a cabo sin problemas hasta que el ladrón descubre un polizón en su coche de huida: la esposa embarazada de Temple, Mia.

programme.title: En el juego del Asesino
programme.desc: La policía detiene a un psicópata al que se le relaciona con múltiples raptos y asesinatos de mujeres, pero su captura será solo el principio de una cuenta atrás en busca de sus víctimas

programme.title: El cascanueces
programme.desc: Esta alegre interpretación del clásico navideño cuenta la historia de una niña cuyo amor por un juguete lo transforma en un apuesto príncipe (Macaulay Culkin).

programme.title: Un extraño en Sugarcreek
programme.desc: Rachel Troyer es una mujer policía en la pintoresca población de Sugarcreek. Con frecuencia visita a sus tías Amish, que la criaron cuando se quedó huérfana. Cuando un vagabundo aparece con su hijo de cinco años, las bondadosas tías insisten en acogerles.

programme.title: El Pequeño Gangster
programme.desc: Rik Boskamp es hijo de un contable y no soporta el acoso escolar. Viendo una película sobre la Mafia, tiene una idea que le parece brillante.Rik convence a sus padres para que se trasladen a otra ciudad con su familia, para empezar de nuevo en lugar nuevo

programme.title: El Doctor y Sus Mujeres
programme.desc: Un guapo ginecólogo (Richard Gere) en medio de una crisis de la mediana edad, tiene dificultades con su familia, así como con su propia vida.

programme.title: Abajo el Amor
programme.desc: Cuando la exitosa escritora feminista Barbara Novak se convierte en el objetivo del deslumbrante playboy Catcher Block , esta pareja dispareja genera chispas de diversión.

programme.title: Travesuras de una Princesa
programme.desc: La «primera hija» busca una experiencia universitaria normal, pero los peligros inherentes a su título la persiguen. Por ello, el Servicio Secreto asigna a un joven agente encubierto para vigilarla.

programme.title: Crimen en Primer Grado
programme.desc: Claire (Ashley Judd), una abogada dinámica, y su marido (James Caviezel), un contratista independiente de éxito, llevan una vida estupenda. Sin embargo, un delito fortuito en su hogar desencadena una serie de acontecimientos que hace añicos su mundo.

programme.title: Frecuencia Mortal
programme.desc: Lewis Thomas (Paul Walker), estudiante de segundo año de universidad, emprende un viaje por carretera a través del país con la chica de sus sueños, Venna (Leelee Sobieski). Sin embargo, todo se tuerce cuando recoge a su hermano, Fuller (Steve Zahn).

programme.title: A Cure for Wellness
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo debe salvar a su jefe de un "centro de bienestar" que mantiene adictos a sus pacientes.

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: Una pareja descubre una inquietante presencia en fotografías de un supuesto accidente.

programme.title: El Pirata
programme.desc: En los juegos clandestinos la traición y la trampa se pagan con la muerte, así un jugador de altos niveles es apuñalado en el ojo, ahora todos tendrán que conocer la furia del “Pirata”.

programme.title: El Pistolero
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de un ranchero que es reclutado para integrarse al cartel de Sinaloa. Al principio lo hace para llevar a cabo la venganza de su padre, pero después se ve rodeado de tanto poder y dinero, que ya no le es posible dejar el negocio.

programme.title: El Regreso Del Campero
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Lagunillas, Michoacan, vive Don Ramiro Del Campo mejor conocido como El Marcado es el hombre mas rico del pueblo quien cobra mucho dinero por el uso del agua.

programme.title: El Sinvergüenza
programme.desc: Roberto esta a cargo del instituto de idiomas que en realidad es un prostibulo. Su misión es convencer a mujeres para que trabajen como prostitutas dentro del instituto. Sin embargo, conoce a Isabel a quien no consigue convencer y se enamora de ella.

programme.title: El Super Macho
programme.desc: Leviton, trabaja de mesero en la cafeteria de la universidad donde estudia para pagar su colegiatura. El, le ayuda a un profesor de ciencias con uno de sus experimentos que consiste en convertir al humilde y debilucho mesero en un súper hombre.

programme.title: El Tren De La Muerte
programme.desc: El pistolero Alvaro llega a un pueblo dominado por tres bandidos a los que busca para vengar el asesinato de su familia. Antes de que pase el siguiente tren, se enfrenta con cada bandido y los mata con ayuda del pistolero mexicano Toni López.

programme.title: Nostradamus Y El Destructor De Monstruos
programme.desc: El estudiante y la horca: dos estudiantes de medicina piden permiso al guardián de la prisión para utilizar un cadáver para un experimento, pero ante la negativa, tratan de hurtar el cuerpo.

programme.title: Bajo Amenaza
programme.desc: Jeff Talley, un ex negociador de rehenes, intenta rescatar a una familia secuestrada en su nueva ciudad. Sin embargo, el padre de la familia guarda secretos peligrosos y delincuentes inestables complican su misión.

programme.title: Guerra Urbana
programme.desc: El pasado Black Ops de Kane está causando incertidumbre en el futuro del equipo SIU.

programme.title: La venganza es mía
programme.desc: Tras el ataque a su estación de policía, Kane entierra a sus amigos y se propone vengar sus muertes. Reúne un nuevo equipo y sigue el camino que cruza la frontera hasta Vancouver.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Aprisionados por un grupo rebelde de jem'hadar, Bashir y O'Brien se enfrentan porque Bashir quiere ayudar a sus captores a escapar del régimen del Dominio.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Kira Nerys debe aceptar que Gul Dukat le acompañe en una investigación en el sistema Dozaria acerca de una nave cardasiana que desapareció seis años atrás cuando transportaba a un numeroso grupo de prisioneros bajoranos, entre ellos un amigo suyo.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Jadzia Dax debe elegir entre sus sentimientos y las reglas de la sociedad trill cuando se reencuentra con la esposa de uno de los huéspedes anteriores de Dax.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Una batalla encarnizada con los jem'hadar deja a la Defiant atrapada en una atmósfera volátil.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Un accidente lleva a Quark, Rom y Nog a la Tierra al año 1947. Llegan a Roswell, Nuevo México, donde las fuerzas militares los confunden con invasores alienígenas.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine
programme.desc: Worf, Dax y el respetado guerrero klingon Kor emprenden la búsqueda de un artefacto mítico antiguo que creen que tiene el poder de unir al Imperio klingon.

programme.title: Avenida Cloverfield 10
programme.desc: Después de un accidente de autos, una mujer despierta en el búnker de un supervivencialista. Él afirma haberla salvado de un ataque apocalíptico, pero al sospechar de sus intenciones, ella deberá escapar para descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Snakes on a Train
programme.desc: Bajo una poderosa maldición maya, las serpientes son incubadas dentro de una mujer joven, lentamente devorándola desde adentro. Su única posibilidad de sobrevivir es una poderosa chamán que vive al otro lado de la frontera.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: La Vida de Pedro Infante
programme.desc: Una historia emotiva y tierna basada en la vida real de Pedro Infante, el cantante y actor más famoso de México. Sus comienzos, sus triunfos, su pasión por los aviones, sus amores y su trágica muerte en plena flor de su edad.

programme.title: La edad de la tentación
programme.desc: La negligencia de los padres que no asumen su responsabilidad en la educación sexual de los hijos provoca la ruina de muchas vidas.

programme.title: La flecha envenenada

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean salva a un gatito de un árbol. La prensa y el dueño del gatito llegan a su puerta para tomar una fotografía, pero el cabello de Bean está desordenado, por lo que decide cortarse el pelo."

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere ver un programa en la televisión, pero los vecinos no mantendrán el ruido bajo. No hay lugar en su casa para escapar de tan odioso sonido. Bean comienza a tener pensamientos de venganza.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
